name: The policy, end to end
caption: Each frame becomes one token (sₜ, aₜ₋₁). A causal context Transformer reads the sequence; its state for the current frame, hₜ, is handed to a causal action decoder that writes aₜ, aₜ₊₁, … in order. The first two are played, the rest are replaced by the next plan.

name: What a predicted action is given
caption: The four O37 cells, same parameters, data, updates and deployment. Across-frame feedback hands the decoder the frames it has already written; within-frame feedback chains the four controller groups. Averaged over the other axis, across-frame feedback was worth +0.361 stocks/min and +13.49 damage/min, within-frame feedback +0.245 and +8.48.

name: Three paths into the action logits
caption: O43 arm A feeds the action logits three ways: the temporal decoder’s future-frame state, conditioned within the frame by FiLM and read by a SiLU MLP head, plus a direct skip from the trunk state. Removing any one of them cost stocks on both evaluation suites; hover a row to see the path it removed.

name: Run-length action spans
caption: O18 packed the four controller groups into one symbol per frame and let BPE merge repeated holds into span tokens of up to 16 frames. The compression was real; executing a token to completion was not, and the package lost 2.6 stocks per minute.

name: The observation token
caption: Every source of one token. Player blocks carry a validity mask; an absent follower is all zeros with its mask set. The four projectile slots share one encoder whose output is multiplied by the slot’s presence flag before the sum, so an empty slot adds exactly zero and order does not matter. Characters, stage and the player identity are embedded directly. The previous controller frame enters as the classes the decoder predicts, each class carrying its learned embedding and the physical stick or trigger value.

name: Reward, return and weight, frame by frame
caption: One game from the ego port’s side. Damage dealt and taken and stock changes are the reward; the return discounts it with the chosen half-life; the weight is the capped exponential of the return over a baseline, divided by β. The knobs default to the O52 values.
